deviations.what: c7 S3 *Ledger index*: the FAB covers the last account's balance once the list is longer than the screen. The captures show it already: S3__default__android360 and S3__opening-not-set__android360 draw the FAB over the Ramesh and Shop sales rows' figures
deviations.reason: [screen] defect — a reachable state where a balance cannot be read at any scroll position; the cure is bottom padding the FAB's height (or no FAB, as the frame draws). s3_ledger_index_screen.dart is the ledger lane's, not this audit's
